name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid-chest.
Push the bar back up explosively to starting position, keeping your back slightly arched.
start_pos: Lie on bench, arms fully extended holding barbell over chest.
movement: Lower the barbell vertically to touch the sternum.
end_pos: Push the barbell back to the starting point.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees, holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the weights upward until arms are extended above your chest.
Lower the weights slowly under control back to starting position.
start_pos: Seated on incline bench, dumbbells held at shoulder level.
movement: Press dumbbells upwards vertically.
end_pos: Dumbbells are at peak position, arms extended, then lower them.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Push-ups
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower your body until your chest almost touches the floor, keeping core tight and back straight.
Push back up to the starting position.
start_pos: Plank position, hands under shoulders, toes on the floor.
movement: Bend elbows to lower chest toward the floor.
end_pos: Push back up until arms are straight.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above chest, palms facing each other.
Lower weights out to sides in a wide arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze chest to return dumbbells to starting position.
start_pos: Flat on bench, dumbbells held above chest, palms facing.
movement: Open arms wide in arc until chest stretches.
end_pos: Bring dumbbells back together over chest.
common_mistakes: Bending elbows too much (making it a press)
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a pulldown station and grip bar wider than shoulders.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest while leaning back slightly.
Slowly return the bar to the start position.
start_pos: Seated at lat pulldown machine, arms extended, gripping bar.
movement: Pull bar down toward collarbone, squeezing shoulder blades.
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: One Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on a flat bench, keeping back flat and parallel to floor.
Hold a dumbbell in opposite hand, arm hanging straight down.
Pull the dumbbell up to your hip, keeping elbow close to side.
Lower weight back to start position.
start_pos: One knee/hand on bench, other arm holding dumbbell down.
movement: Pull dumbbell up to ribcage/hip.
end_pos: Lower dumbbell back to full arm extension.
common_mistakes: Pulling with biceps instead of lat
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, bend forward from hips at 45 degrees.
Grip barbell with overhand grip and pull to upper abdomen.
Slowly lower back to start.
start_pos: Hip-hinged stance, holding barbell hanging straight down.
movement: Pull barbell to belly button, elbows high.
end_pos: Return bar down to starting hang.
common_mistakes: Using legs to lift the weight
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press dumbbells straight overhead until arms are locked.
Lower weights back to shoulders under control.
start_pos: Standing or sitting, dumbbells held at ear level.
movement: Press dumbbells vertically over head.
end_pos: Dumbbells overhead close together, then lower to ears.
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, holding dumbbells at sides.
Raise arms out to sides with slight elbow bend until parallel to floor.
Slowly lower weights to sides.
start_pos: Stand straight, dumbbells at sides.
movement: Raise arms sideways to shoulder level.
end_pos: Hold briefly at parallel, then lower.
common_mistakes: Leading with hands instead of elbows
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes pointed slightly outward.
Push hips back and bend knees, lowering body as if sitting in a chair.
Keep chest up and knees aligned with toes. Lower until thighs are parallel to floor.
Drive through heels to return to standing position.
start_pos: Stand erect, feet shoulder-width, arms forward or at chest.
movement: Lower hips down, bending knees while keeping back straight.
end_pos: Thighs parallel or below, drive upward to start pos.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Lunges
instructions: Stand tall, step forward with one leg.
Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to floor and back knee is just above floor.
Push off front foot to return to standing position. Switch legs.
start_pos: Standing feet together, hands on hips.
movement: Step forward and sink hips down vertically.
end_pos: Both knees at 90 degrees, drive back up.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit on leg extension machine, shins behind rollers.
Extend knees fully to lift weight, squeezing quads at top.
Lower weight slowly to start position.
start_pos: Seated on machine, knees bent at 90 degrees.
movement: Straighten legs upward.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down or sit on leg curl machine, ankles under pads.
Curl legs up toward glutes, squeezing hamstrings.
Slowly extend legs back to start.
start_pos: Positioned on curl machine, legs fully extended.
movement: Pull heels toward butt.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Calf Raises
instructions: Stand on edge of step on balls of feet.
Lower heels down below step level to stretch calves.
Press up onto toes as high as possible, squeezing calves.
start_pos: Balls of feet on step edge, heels hanging.
movement: Rise high onto balls of feet.
end_pos: Lower heels slowly to deep stretch.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding barbell with underhand grip, shoulder-width.
Keep elbows tucked near waist, curl bar up toward shoulders.
Lower bar slowly to start.
start_pos: Standing straight, barbell held at thighs.
movement: Curl barbell upward using biceps.
end_pos: Bar at chest level, squeeze, then lower.
common_mistakes: Not extending arm fully at bottom
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides, palms facing inward (neutral grip).
Curl weights up while keeping palms facing each other.
Lower weights back to sides.
start_pos: Stand straight, dumbbells at sides, palms inward.
movement: Curl dumbbells up, maintaining neutral palms.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Cable Pushdown
instructions: Face cable machine, grip bar/rope at chest level with elbows tucked.
Push bar/rope down until arms are fully extended.
Slowly return to start, keeping elbows locked at sides.
start_pos: Grip attachment at chest, elbows bent at 90, tucked in.
movement: Push attachment down to thighs.
end_pos: Arms fully straight, lock triceps, then return.
common_mistakes: Letting bar fly up too fast
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Extension
instructions: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lower weight behind head by bending elbows, keeping upper arms still.
Extend elbows to push dumbbell back overhead.
start_pos: Sit, holding dumbbell vertical overhead in both hands.
movement: Lower dumbbell behind neck, bending elbows.
end_pos: Press dumbbell back to high starting position.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Plank
instructions: Place forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders.
Extend legs back, toes on floor, lift hips into straight line.
Contract abs, squeeze glutes, and hold for time.
start_pos: Resting on forearms and toes, body elevated.
movement: Static hold, contracting full body.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat on floor.
Place hands lightly behind head or crossed over chest.
Contract abs to lift shoulders off floor, exhaling.
Slowly lower back down.
start_pos: Lie flat, knees bent at 90, feet flat.
movement: Lift shoulder blades 2-3 inches off floor.
end_pos: Squeeze abs at top, then lower.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Leg Raises
instructions: Lie on your back, legs straight, hands under hips for support.
Slowly raise legs up to 90 degrees.
Lower legs slowly back down until they are just above the floor.
start_pos: Lie flat on back, legs extended straight.
movement: Raise legs vertically without bending knees.
end_pos: Legs vertical, lower them slowly without touching floor.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall, chest out, shoulders back. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping elbows close to your torso, curl the weights up toward shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells under control to the start position.
start_pos: Stand upright with dumbbells held at sides, palms facing front.
movement: Flex elbows to bring dumbbells to shoulders.
end_pos: Bring dumbbells to peak elevation, squeeze bicep, then slowly descend.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Dumbbell Squats
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, hanging at your sides (or hold one at chest level).
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body by bending at hips and knees, keeping chest high.
Push back up to starting position.
start_pos: Stand erect holding dumbbells at sides or shoulders.
movement: Lower hips down into squat depth.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest level.
Grip handles and step forward to create tension.
Press handles forward, extending arms fully.
Control handles back to starting position.
start_pos: Hold band handles at chest height, anchor behind you.
movement: Press bands straight forward.
end_pos: Fully extend arms, squeeze chest, return to chest height.
coaching_cues: Keep your shoulder blades retracted and depressed.
Lower the weight slowly under full control.
Exhale as you press upward.
Squeeze your inner chest at the top of the movement.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Rest barbell across upper back muscles (traps).
Unrack bar, step back, set feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower hips until thighs are parallel to ground.
Drive upward through heels to return to start.
start_pos: Barbell supported on upper back, tall chest, feet shoulder width.
movement: Descend by flexing hips and knees.
end_pos: Parallel squat depth, explode back to standing.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of thighs with slight knee bend.
Hinge forward at hips, pushing glutes back while keeping spine flat.
Lower weights along shins until hamstrings stretch deeply.
Contract hamstrings and glutes to return to upright posture.
start_pos: Standing straight holding weights in front of thighs.
movement: Hinge at hips pushing hips backward.
end_pos: Deep hamstring stretch at shin level, pull hips forward to stand.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on bench edge, brace tricep against inner thigh.
Curl dumbbell upward toward shoulder without moving upper arm.
Squeeze bicep at peak and lower under control.
start_pos: Seated, arm extended down with elbow braced against thigh.
movement: Flex elbow to curl weight upward.
end_pos: Peak bicep contraction, lower back down.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Russian Twists
instructions: Sit on floor, lean back slightly at 45 degrees with knees bent.
Interlock hands or hold weight, rotate torso to right side.
Pause briefly, then rotate smoothly to left side.
start_pos: V-sit torso angle, feet hovering or heels lightly touching.
movement: Twist shoulders side to side.
end_pos: Alternating side tap with controlled core tension.
common_mistakes: Twisting arms only instead of shoulders
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on upright bench holding dumbbells at ear level.
Press dumbbells directly overhead until arms lock out.
Lower under control back to ear level.
start_pos: Seated upright, dumbbells at ear height.
movement: Press dumbbells vertically overhead.
end_pos: Arms extended overhead, then lower slowly.
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Tricep Dips
instructions: Place hands on bench or chair behind you, feet extended forward.
Lower hips by bending elbows until upper arms are parallel to floor.
Press through palms to push back up.
start_pos: Hands on bench edge, body suspended, knees/legs extended.
movement: Bend elbows straight back to lower body.
end_pos: Elbows at 90 degrees, press up to straight arms.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Pull-ups
instructions: Grip pull-up bar overhand slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull chest up to bar by driving elbows down toward hips.
Lower body with full control until arms are extended.
start_pos: Dead hang on bar, arms fully extended.
movement: Pull body up until chin clears bar.
end_pos: Chin above bar, lower back down slowly.
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against chest with both palms supporting head.
Stand with feet shoulder-width, squat down until elbows touch inside of knees.
Drive back up standing tall.
start_pos: Standing straight holding dumbbell at chest.
movement: Lower hips deep, knees tracking toes.
end_pos: Deep squat position, explode to standing.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Position upper arms flat against the preacher bench pad.
Grip the bar or dumbbells shoulder-width apart.
Lower weight under control until arms are extended.
Curl the weight up towards shoulders squeezing biceps.
start_pos: Arms resting over preacher pad, holding weight extended.
movement: Flex elbows to curl weight upward.
end_pos: Peak contraction at top, then lower smoothly.
safety_notes: Do not drop weights at bottom extension.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Attach bar to low cable pulley station.
Stand upright holding bar with underhand grip.
Curl bar towards chest keeping elbows pinned to sides.
Lower under constant cable tension.
start_pos: Standing tall, holding cable bar at thighs.
movement: Curl bar upward towards shoulders.
end_pos: Squeeze biceps at top, return slowly.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit back on incline bench set to 45-60 degrees.
Let arms hang fully extended holding dumbbells.
Curl dumbbells up supinating wrists at top.
Lower weights under strict control.
start_pos: Seated on incline bench, arms hanging straight down.
movement: Curl weights upward keeping upper arms back.
end_pos: Full contraction at top, return under stretch.
safety_notes: Maintain shoulder blade contact with bench.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Do not swing your torso for momentum.
Squeeze your biceps hard at peak contraction.
Lower the weight with a 3-second negative.

name: Skull Crushers
instructions: Lie on flat bench holding EZ bar above chest.
Bend elbows lowering weight towards forehead.
Extend elbows pushing weight back over chest.
start_pos: Lying flat, bar held vertically above shoulders.
movement: Hinge at elbows lowering bar toward forehead.
end_pos: Press back to arm extension over chest.
safety_notes: Use secure overhand grip; use spotter if heavy.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on flat bench gripping barbell shoulder-width apart.
Lower bar to lower chest keeping elbows tucked.
Press bar straight back up to arm lockout.
start_pos: Lie on bench, bar held shoulder-width above chest.
movement: Lower bar to sternum keeping elbows close.
common_mistakes: Grip too narrow causing wrist pain
safety_notes: Keep thumbs wrapped securely around bar.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows fixed in place.
Focus on extending fully at the elbow joint.
Keep your core tight to prevent arching.
Control the return phase.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit facing cable row station with feet on footrests.
Grip handle and pull towards lower abdomen.
Squeeze shoulder blades together at end range.
Extend arms forward smoothly.
start_pos: Seated upright, arms extended holding cable attachment.
movement: Pull handle back squeezing lat muscles.
end_pos: Handle near abdomen, then release under control.
safety_notes: Keep chest proud and spine neutral.
coaching_cues: Lead the movement with your elbows.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Pull through your lats, not your biceps.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Sit on bench holding dumbbells at chest level with palms facing in.
Rotate wrists while pressing dumbbells overhead.
At top extension, palms face forward.
Lower and rotate back to starting position.
start_pos: Seated, dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms inward.
movement: Press up while rotating palms outward.
end_pos: Overhead extension with palms facing forward.
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Reverse Fly
instructions: Bend forward at hips keeping flat back posture.
Hold light dumbbells under chest with slight elbow bend.
Raise arms out to sides until elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower weights under control.
start_pos: Hinged forward, arms hanging below chest.
movement: Raise arms laterally squeezing rear delts.
end_pos: Arms parallel to floor, return under control.
safety_notes: Use moderate weight to preserve isolation.
coaching_cues: Avoid shrugging your shoulders during the movement.
Keep your core braced and glutes engaged.
Control the lowering phase completely.
Press overhead in a natural arc.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest upper back against sturdy bench, feet flat on floor.
Position barbell across hip crease.
Drive through heels extending hips toward ceiling.
Squeeze glutes at peak then lower under control.
start_pos: Seated against bench with hips down and bar loaded.
movement: Push hips upward until torso is horizontal.
end_pos: Peak glute contraction at top, return down.
safety_notes: Use barbell pad for hip cushion.
coaching_cues: Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Avoid hyper-extending your lower back at peak extension.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in leg press machine with feet shoulder-width on platform.
Release safety handles and lower platform toward chest.
Press platform back up using quads without locking knees.
start_pos: Seated with legs extended holding machine platform.
movement: Lower platform bending knees to 90 degrees.
end_pos: Press platform back up to starting position.
safety_notes: Keep lumbar spine pressed firmly against backrest.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Wrist Curls
instructions: Rest forearms on bench with palms facing up and wrists hanging off edge.
Hold dumbbells and curl wrists upward.
Lower dumbbells slowly to feel deep forearm stretch.
start_pos: Forearms flat on bench, wrists hanging with dumbbells.
movement: Flex wrists upward squeezing forearm muscles.
end_pos: Lower wrists back down under full stretch.
safety_notes: Use light weight to avoid wrist joint strain.
coaching_cues: Use a full range of motion at your wrist.
Keep your forearm resting securely.
Perform smooth, controlled repetitions.

name: Farmers Walk
instructions: Stand tall holding heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Brace core and walk forward taking smooth steps.
Maintain erect posture and tight grip throughout.
start_pos: Standing upright holding dumbbells at sides.
movement: Walk controlled distance with chest high.
end_pos: Set weights down safely when finished.
safety_notes: Brace abs and keep spine straight.
coaching_cues: Use a full range of motion at your wrist.
Keep your forearm resting securely.
Perform smooth, controlled repetitions.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on padded mat holding ab roller handles.
Roll wheel forward extending arms and body.
Contract abs pulling wheel back to knees.
start_pos: Kneeling, ab wheel directly below shoulders.
movement: Roll wheel forward until body is near floor.
safety_notes: Do not extend farther than abs can support.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand lunge distance in front of bench with rear foot elevated.
Lower hips by bending front knee to 90 degrees.
Drive through front heel to return to top.
start_pos: One leg elevated on bench, standing on front leg.
movement: Lower hips vertically bending front knee.
end_pos: Push back up to upright standing position.
safety_notes: Master bodyweight balance before adding dumbbells.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on side resting on elbow and forearm.
Lift hips until body forms straight diagonal line.
Hold position bracing obliques.
start_pos: Lying on side, elbow stacked under shoulder.
movement: Raise hips off floor holding alignment.
safety_notes: Keep neck in neutral alignment with spine.
coaching_cues: Maintain controlled form throughout.
Focus on the target muscle.
Breathe regularly.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure legs on decline bench
Unrack barbell over lower chest
Lower bar smoothly to lower pectorals
Press back up to lock out.
start_pos: Secured on decline bench, bar over lower chest.
movement: Lower to lower sternum.
common_mistakes: Bar touching too high on chest
safety_notes: Always lock your legs into the pads securely.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place hands on an elevated bench or sturdy platform
Keep body in straight line
Lower chest to edge of platform
Push back up.
start_pos: Plank with hands elevated on bench.
movement: Lower body towards platform.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place feet on bench or elevated surface and hands on the floor
Lower chest to floor under control
Press back up.
start_pos: Feet elevated, hands on floor in plank.
movement: Lower chest toward floor.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Set high pulleys with D-handles
Take a slight forward lunge stance
Bring handles down and together across front of hips
Squeeze chest firmly at peak.
start_pos: Standing between cable pulleys, slight forward lean.
movement: Sweep arms forward and down in an arc.
end_pos: Hands meet in front of pelvis, chest contracted.

name: Chest Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars, lean torso forward 30 degrees
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees
Push through chest back up.
start_pos: Supported on dip bars, leaning forward.
movement: Lower torso with forward lean.
end_pos: Press back up to lock out.
safety_notes: Stop at 90-degree elbow bend if you feel shoulder pinch.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust seat height so handles align with mid-chest
Press handles forward until arms are almost straight
Return slowly.
start_pos: Seated back against pad, handles at chest level.
movement: Press handles away from chest.
safety_notes: Keep shoulder blades pinned to the back pad.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Sit with back firmly against pad, grasp handles or pads with forearms
Bring arms together in front of chest
Hold contraction 1 sec then return.
start_pos: Arms open out to sides on machine pads.
movement: Squeeze arms together horizontally.
end_pos: Pads touch or meet at midline.
safety_notes: Keep chest high and shoulders depressed.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent, holding dumbbells at chest
Press up until arms are straight
Lower until triceps lightly touch the floor, pause, and press.
start_pos: Supine on floor, triceps resting on ground holding dumbbells.
movement: Press dumbbells upwards vertically.
common_mistakes: Bouncing elbows hard on the floor

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, barbell over midfoot
Hinge down, grip bar just outside shins
Brace core, drive through the floor to stand upright
Lower bar with controlled hip hinge.
start_pos: Hinged down at bar, shins touching bar, spine locked flat.
movement: Drive hips and knees to lock out vertically.
safety_notes: Brace intra-abdominal pressure firmly before pulling.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Grip bar underhand shoulder-width
Pull chest up to bar focusing on bicep and lat pull
Lower slowly.
start_pos: Hanging with supinated grip.
movement: Pull body up to chin over bar.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle T-bar platform with hips hinged
Grip handles and pull weight towards chest
Squeeze middle back, lower slowly.
start_pos: Hinged over T-bar handles.
movement: Pull weight into upper abdomen.
safety_notes: Keep knees soft and lower back flat.

name: Inverted Bodyweight Row
instructions: Position bar in rack at waist height
Lie underneath, grip bar with overhand grip
Pull chest to bar keeping body plank-straight.
start_pos: Hanging under bar with heels on floor, body straight.
movement: Pull chest to bar.
safety_notes: Adjust bar higher to make it easier.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing high cable with straight bar or rope
Keeping arms almost straight, sweep bar down to thighs
Squeeze lats at bottom.
start_pos: Standing hinged 30 deg, arms extended holding cable bar high.
movement: Sweep bar in arc down to thighs.
end_pos: Bar at upper thighs, lats contracted.
safety_notes: Lock elbow angle and move only through shoulder joint.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold barbell in front of thighs with shoulder-width grip
Elevate shoulders straight up towards ears
Hold 1 sec, lower smoothly.
start_pos: Standing tall holding barbell at arms length.
movement: Shrug shoulders vertically.
safety_notes: Move straight up and down, do not roll.

name: Hyperextensions
instructions: Lock legs into 45-degree hyperextension bench
Cross arms over chest, hinge down at hips
Raise torso until aligned with legs.
start_pos: Hips resting against pad, torso hinged down.
movement: Extend spine and hips upward.
safety_notes: Stop when body is in a straight line.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Attach single handle to lowest cable pulley
Stand sideways, pull handle across body out to shoulder height
Lower with resistance.
start_pos: Cable across body at hip.
movement: Raise arm laterally to 90 degrees.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set rope attachment at eye level on cable machine
Pull rope ends towards eyes, separating hands and rotating forearms up
Hold 1 sec, extend arms smoothly.
start_pos: Standing holding rope with arms straight in front.
movement: Pull rope towards bridge of nose, externally rotating shoulders.
end_pos: Hands by ears with elbows high.
safety_notes: Essential for shoulder health and posture.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs
Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height
Lower under control.
start_pos: Standing holding dumbbells against thighs.
movement: Raise straight arm forward.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Get into downward dog position with hips high in an inverted V
Lower top of head towards floor between hands
Press back up through shoulders.
start_pos: Inverted V-shape with hands on floor and hips high.
movement: Lower head diagonally forward.
end_pos: Press back up to pike apex.
common_mistakes: Letting hips drop into regular pushup
safety_notes: Great bodyweight alternative to overhead press.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Grip bar with shoulder-width grip
Pull bar vertically up along torso, driving elbows high
Lower slowly.
start_pos: Standing holding barbell at thighs.
movement: Pull bar upwards leading with elbows.
safety_notes: Keep grip at shoulder width to protect rotator cuff.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench
Let arms hang straight down with dumbbells
Curl weights up without moving upper arms.
start_pos: Prone on incline bench, arms perpendicular to floor.
movement: Curl weights towards forehead.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
instructions: Grip barbell with overhand (pronated) grip
Curl bar up keeping wrists straight
Lower under control.
start_pos: Standing holding barbell with knuckles facing forward.
movement: Curl bar upwards with overhand grip.
safety_notes: Strengthens forearm extensors and upper arm thickness.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Place hands close together on floor under chest forming a diamond with thumbs and index fingers
Lower chest to hands
Press back up.
start_pos: Plank with diamond hand position under sternum.
movement: Lower chest towards hands.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hinge forward at hips, upper arm parallel to torso
Extend forearm backward until arm is straight
Squeeze tricep, return to 90 deg.
start_pos: Bent over, elbow pinned at side at 90 degrees.
movement: Extend dumbbell backward.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Attach rope to high pulley, face away in lunge stance
Extend rope forward and overhead until arms lock out
Bend elbows back slowly.
start_pos: Lunge stance facing away from cable, rope behind head.
movement: Extend arms forward overhead.
end_pos: Arms locked out overhead, ropes spread.
safety_notes: Brace core to keep posture steady.

name: Reverse Wrist Curls
instructions: Rest forearms on bench with palms down
Extend wrists upward
Lower slowly.
start_pos: Forearms on bench, palms facing floor holding dumbbells.
movement: Extend wrists upwards.
safety_notes: Use light weights for wrist health.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip pull-up bar with both hands
Hang freely with feet off floor, breathing deeply
Hold for max duration.
start_pos: Full hanging position from bar.
movement: Hold grip isometric contraction.
safety_notes: Great for grip strength and spinal decompression.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar
Keeping legs straight, raise feet up to bar level
Lower under control without swinging.
start_pos: Dead hang from bar.
movement: Raise toes to bar level.
safety_notes: Bend knees for an easier intermediate progression.

name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with hands behind head, knees bent
Touch right elbow to left knee while extending right leg
Alternate sides smoothly.
start_pos: Supine, shoulders elevated, knees at 90 deg.
movement: Pedal legs while rotating torso across.

name: Cable Woodchopper
instructions: Set high pulley on cable
Stand sideways, grip handle with both hands
Pull diagonally down across body to opposite hip
Return smoothly.
start_pos: Standing sideways to high pulley, arms extended.
movement: Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down.
safety_notes: Pivot back foot as you rotate.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in high plank position
Drive one knee into chest, then switch quickly in a running motion
Maintain flat back.
start_pos: High plank posture.
movement: Rapid alternating knee drives.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Rest barbell on front delts in clean rack position with elbows high
Squat upright until hip crease passes knees
Drive up keeping elbows pointed forward.
start_pos: Bar racked on front shoulders, elbows held high.
movement: Descend with completely upright torso.
safety_notes: Demands strong core and thoracic extension.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position shoulders and back against hack squat sled
Lower sled until knees reach 90 degrees
Press back up through midfoot and heels.
start_pos: Shoulders against pads, feet on platform.
movement: Descend into deep machine squat.
safety_notes: Great isolated quad builder with back support.

name: Walking Lunges
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Step forward into a lunge, lower back knee to ground
Push off back leg to step directly into next forward lunge.
start_pos: Standing tall holding dumbbells.
movement: Continuous walking forward lunges.
safety_notes: Step in train tracks rather than a tightrope.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs
Hinge at hips, pushing glutes back until you feel deep stretch in hamstrings
Return to standing.
start_pos: Standing holding dumbbells at thighs.
movement: Hip hinge down along shins.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat on floor hip-width
Drive through heels to raise hips off floor until aligned with knees
Squeeze glutes at top.
start_pos: Supine with knees bent and feet flat.
movement: Bridge hips upward.
safety_notes: Great warmup or glute hypertrophy exercise.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach ankle cuff to low cable
Kick leg directly backward and slightly out, squeezing glute at peak
Return with control.
start_pos: Facing machine with cuff around ankle.
movement: Extend leg backward against cable.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in machine, secure thigh pad firmly above knees
Curl legs down and back underneath seat
Hold contraction 1 sec, return slowly.
start_pos: Seated with legs extended straight on roller pad.
movement: Curl heels underneath seat.

name: Standing Barbell Calf Raise
instructions: Place barbell across upper back, stand with balls of feet on calf block
Lower heels into deep stretch
Drive up onto toes, squeeze calves.
start_pos: Bar on traps, balls of feet on block.
movement: Rise up onto toes.
safety_notes: Keep knees locked straight to target gastrocnemius.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit at machine with knees bent at 90 deg under pad
Lower heels into full stretch
Press up onto toes, hold 1 sec.
start_pos: Seated with pad over thighs, heels dropped.
movement: Raise heels against resistance.
safety_notes: Directly targets the deeper soleus muscle.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbell in one hand, balance on one foot on a step edge
Lower heel for deep stretch, press up onto big toe
Repeat and switch legs.
start_pos: Standing on single foot on step.
movement: Raise heel up on single leg.
safety_notes: Hold a wall lightly with other hand for balance.

name: Burpees
instructions: From standing, drop into squat and kick feet back into pushup
Perform a pushup, jump feet back to hands, jump explosively with hands overhead.
start_pos: Standing tall.
movement: Drop to pushup, snap feet forward, jump up.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge back with kettlebell between thighs
Snap hips forward explosively to swing kettlebell to chest height
Guide bell back smoothly.
start_pos: Hinged stance holding kettlebell.
movement: Explosive hip extension swings bell forward.
end_pos: Bell at chest height, glutes squeezed.

name: Dumbbell Thrusters
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulders in a front rack
Perform a full squat, then drive up explosively and press dumbbells overhead
Lower weights back to shoulders as you descend into next squat.
start_pos: Standing with dumbbells at shoulders.
movement: Squat down, then drive up into overhead press.
end_pos: Arms locked overhead in full standing extension.
safety_notes: Seamless fluid momentum transfer from legs to shoulders.

name: Barbell Clean and Press
instructions: Pull barbell from floor, explosively clean it onto front deltoids, then press bar overhead
Lower with control to floor.
start_pos: Barbell over midfoot in deadlift setup.
movement: Explosive triple extension into clean rack, then overhead press.
common_mistakes: Arm pulling instead of hip drive
safety_notes: Master clean technique with light weight first.

name: Box Jumps
instructions: Stand in front of sturdy plyo box
Swing arms, hinge hips, and jump onto box landing softly in partial squat
Step down safely.
start_pos: Standing 1-2 feet in front of box.
movement: Explosive jump onto top of box.
end_pos: Soft landing on box, stand tall.
safety_notes: Step down one foot at a time.

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Hold rope ends in half-squat athletic stance
Whip ropes up and down in alternating waves as fast as possible for target time.
start_pos: Athletic quarter squat, holding ropes.
movement: Alternating rhythmic wave slams.

name: Rowing Machine Intervals
instructions: Sit on rower, strap feet
Drive with legs, lean back slightly, pull handle to lower ribs
Extend arms, hinge forward, bend knees back to catch.
start_pos: Catch position: knees bent, arms straight forward.
movement: Leg drive -> hip hinge -> arm pull.
common_mistakes: Pulling with arms before legs push

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold rope handles at hip height
Turn rope with wrists, jumping 1-2 inches off floor on balls of feet
Maintain light steady rhythm.
start_pos: Standing holding jump rope behind heels.
movement: Rhythmic jumping on balls of feet.
safety_notes: Land softly with knees slightly bent.

name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with arms outstretched
Cross arms over chest in hug, then swing them wide open to stretch pectorals dynamically.
start_pos: Standing with arms open wide.
movement: Dynamic arm hugs and swings.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: On all fours, inhale and arch back down, looking up (Cow)
Exhale, round spine up towards ceiling and tuck chin (Cat)
Flow smoothly between postures.
start_pos: Quadruped on hands and knees.
movement: Spinal flexion and extension flow.

name: Worlds Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step into long lunge with hands on floor inside front foot
Drop inside elbow towards floor, then rotate arm up towards ceiling opening chest
Repeat on both sides.
start_pos: Deep lunge with hands inside front foot.
movement: Elbow drops to instep, then rotates high to sky.

name: Hamstring Dynamic Sweep
instructions: Step one heel forward with toes up
Hinge hips back, sweep hands down past foot in a smooth arc, and stand up
Alternate steps.
start_pos: Standing feet hip-width.
movement: Heel tap with sweeping arm hinge.
end_pos: Stand tall, step forward with other foot.
common_mistakes: Bending back instead of hinging hips
safety_notes: Warm up posterior chain prior to leg training.

name: Thoracic Spine Rotations
instructions: Kneel on all fours with one hand behind head
Rotate elbow down towards supporting arm, then flare elbow high towards ceiling
Switch sides.
start_pos: Quadruped with one hand behind ear.
movement: Rotate elbow from under torso high to ceiling.
safety_notes: Improves posture and overhead pressing mobility.

name: Svend Press
instructions: Squeeze weight plates or dumbbell between flat palms in front of chest
Press hands straight forward while maintaining maximal inward squeeze
Pull back to chest.
start_pos: Standing tall, pressing weight between palms at sternum.
movement: Extend arms forward horizontally under continuous inward pressure.
common_mistakes: Gripping edges instead of pressing flat palms

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Stand in staggered stance holding end of landmine barbell at shoulder
Press barbell diagonally upward until arm is straight
Lower back to shoulder under control.
start_pos: Staggered stance holding end of barbell at collarbone.
movement: Press diagonally upward along natural bar arc.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand holding a sturdy pole or wall for balance
Rise onto toes and lean torso back in a straight line while driving knees forward
Lower until knees are in deep flexion, drive quads to stand.
start_pos: Standing tall on toes, holding support.
movement: Torso leans back as knees push forward.
end_pos: Deep quad stretch, return to top.
common_mistakes: Bending at hips instead of knees

name: Cable Rope Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Set low or mid cable with rope
Turn away, hold rope behind head, extend arms forward/upward
Spread rope apart at full extension.
start_pos: Staggered stance facing away, rope behind neck.
movement: Extend forearms forward.
end_pos: Arms straight overhead, rope ends apart.
safety_notes: Long head tricep builder with continuous tension.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold kettlebell by horns against chest
Squat deep, keeping chest tall
Drive up through feet.
start_pos: Standing holding kettlebell at chest.
movement: Squat down between legs.
safety_notes: Keep kettlebell in contact with sternum.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on floor with knees bent and barbell across hips
Drive through heels to bridge hips upward
Squeeze glutes 2 sec at top, lower slowly.
start_pos: Supine with loaded bar on hips.
movement: Bridge pelvis upward.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
instructions: Pinch two smooth weight plates together with fingers and thumb
Stand tall and hold for time without letting plates slip.
start_pos: Standing holding weight plates pinched in fingers.
movement: Hold static pinch grip.
safety_notes: Increases thumb pinch strength and grip tenacity.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean back flat against wall, slide down until thighs are parallel to ground
Hold static 90-degree knee angle for target duration.
start_pos: Back against wall, knees bent at 90 degrees.
movement: Hold isometric wall sit.
safety_notes: Keep knees stacked directly above ankles.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on back, press lower spine into floor
Raise arms overhead and legs 6 inches off floor, creating a shallow banana curve
Hold position.
start_pos: Supine with lower back sealed to ground.
movement: Elevate arms and legs into hollow shape.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with wide stance, toes flared 45 degrees
Hinge hips back and grip kettlebell handle with both hands
Drive through heels to stand.
start_pos: Wide sumo stance over kettlebell.
movement: Drive hips forward to stand tall.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
instructions: Grip single handle on cable machine in athletic stance
Pull elbow back past torso, rotating slightly for deep lat contraction.
start_pos: Standing facing cable with arm extended.
movement: Drive elbow back into hip.
end_pos: Handle at ribs with lat fully contracted.

name: Downward-Facing Dog
instructions: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your toes, lift your knees off the mat, and reach your sit bones up toward the ceiling.
Press firmly into palms, draw your shoulder blades down your back, and extend through your heels.
Hold for 5-8 steady breaths, relaxing your head between your upper arms.
start_pos: Tabletop position on hands and knees.
movement: Push hips up and back into an inverted V-shape.
end_pos: Full inverted V with lengthened spine and grounded heels.
safety_notes: Keep slight micro-bend in knees if hamstrings are tight.

name: Warrior II
instructions: Step feet 3-4 feet apart, turn front foot out 90 degrees and back foot in slightly.
Bend front knee over ankle to 90 degrees while keeping back leg straight and strong.
Extend arms horizontally parallel to the floor, actively reaching through fingertips.
Gaze forward over the front middle finger while keeping torso centered over pelvis.
start_pos: Wide standing stance.
movement: Deepen front knee to 90 degrees and extend arms.
end_pos: Solid warrior stance with level pelvis and horizontal arms.
safety_notes: Stack front knee directly above front heel.

name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel on the mat with big toes touching and knees hip-width apart.
Sit back on your heels and fold forward, extending your torso between your thighs.
Rest your forehead on the mat and reach arms forward with palms down.
Breathe deeply into your lower back and hold peacefully.
start_pos: Kneeling on heels.
movement: Fold forward extending arms on the mat.
end_pos: Resting forward fold with hips on heels.
safety_notes: Place a bolster or block under hips or forehead if comfortable.

name: Cobra Pose
instructions: Lie prone on your stomach with tops of feet flat and hands under shoulders.
Hug elbows into your ribcage and press pelvic bone gently into the floor.
Inhale and lift your chest off the mat using your back muscles, keeping neck long.
Hold for 3-5 breaths, then lower slowly on an exhale.
start_pos: Prone on stomach with hands beside chest.
movement: Inhale and lift sternum forward and upward.
end_pos: Gentle upper chest extension with soft elbows.
common_mistakes: Pushing too hard with arms and crunching lower back
safety_notes: Focus on opening thoracic spine rather than bending lower back.

name: Cat-Cow Pose
instructions: Start on hands and knees with neutral spine.
Inhale into Cow: drop belly down, lift sit bones and gaze gently upward.
Exhale into Cat: draw navel to spine, round back toward ceiling, and tuck chin.
Flow continuously with your breath for 10-12 smooth cycles.
start_pos: Neutral tabletop position.
movement: Inhale arching into Cow, exhale rounding into Cat.
end_pos: Full spinal flexion and extension rhythm.
common_mistakes: Moving from neck only instead of entire spine
safety_notes: Move slowly and honor your spine's natural range.

name: Tree Pose
instructions: Stand tall in Mountain Pose and shift weight onto your left foot.
Place right sole on inner left calf or inner left thigh (avoiding the knee joint).
Bring palms together at heart center or reach arms overhead.
Fix your gaze on an unmoving point (Drishti) and balance steadily.
start_pos: Standing mountain pose.
movement: Root standing foot and place sole on inner leg.
end_pos: Stable single-leg balance with open hip.
common_mistakes: Placing foot directly on the knee joint
safety_notes: Use wall support if working on initial balance.
